title: Residence Of Tao Chien-Hwa, Alleged Traitor

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch Division
REPORT
File No. .../ATN
S. B. REGIST
No. S. B. D...
Date January 26, 1939.

Subject Lane 33, 10 Chang Ka Zah Road, off Carter Road - Residence of
Tao Chien-hwa, alleged traitor.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford

With reference to the secret national salvation
periodical "Labourer" dated January 1, which gave an
address of an alleged traitor named Tao Chien-hwa (陶建華),
at Lane 33, 10 Chang Ka Zah Road, enquiries have been made
at this address and reveal that Tao Chien-hwa removed from
the house mentioned about one month ago. Two old ladies
now occupy the rear upstairs room of this address, one being
the mother and the other, the mother-in-law of Tao Chien-hwa.
It is known that Tao and his wife visit this address
frequently.

Tao Chien-hwa now resides at 569 Chekiang Road and
operates the "Jui Sz Trading Company" (求是實業公司), which
forms the subject of another Special Branch report dated
January 20, 1939. It is reported that he concurrently holds
the position of a staff employee of the 2nd Department of the
"Bureau of Social Affairs of the Shanghai City Government"
(Reformed Government).

In 1930, he served in the Publication Section of the
Political Department of the Military Affairs Commission of
the National Government at Nanking as a writer. In 1936,
when General Chiang Kai-shek was detained at Sian, he was
requested by General Tsai Ching-chun, then Commissioner of
the Police Bureau of the Shanghai City Government, to
proceed to Sian and negotiate with General Tan Dzu-sing
(談自新) in charge of the 10th Cavalry Division then
stationed at Sian, who was an intimate friend of Tao, for
the release of the Generalissimo.

（左侧批注：X See D.9027）
（左侧印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 26.1.39）
（左下角印章：FILE）

日期：1939年1月26日。

事由：卡德路（Carter Road）旁张家宅路（Chang Ka Zah Road）10号33弄——涉嫌汉奸陶建華之住所。

呈报人：侦探副督察 高延根（Kao Yen-ken） 转呈人：C. Crawford

鉴于1月1日出版的秘密抗日救国刊物《劳工》（Labourer）刊登了一名涉嫌汉奸陶建華（陶建華）的地址，即张家宅路10号33弄，经对该地址进行调查，发现陶建華约于一个月前搬离该寓所。目前该地址的后楼房间由两位老妇人居住，一位是陶建華的母亲，另一位是其岳母。据悉，陶建華及其妻子经常前往该地址。

陶建華现居住于浙江路569号，经营“求是实业公司”（Jui Sz Trading Company），该公司系另一份日期为1939年1月20日的特务科报告的主题。据报，他同时兼任“上海市政府社会局”（维新政府）第二科的职员。

1930年，他在南京国民政府军事委员会政治部宣传处担任撰稿人。1936年蒋介石将军在西安被扣期间，时任上海市政府警察局局长的蔡劲军将军要求他前往西安，与当时驻守西安、负责第十骑兵师且为陶建華挚友的谭自新将军（談自新）进行谈判，以争取释放委员长。

（左侧批注：X 见 D.9027）
（左侧印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科 1939年1月26日）
（左下角印章：归档）

Tao Chien-hwa has an elder brother named Tao Sih-sung
(陶雪生), who was well-known as the commander of
guerrilla warfare units in Pootung. Tao Sih-sung's men
are believed to have joined forces with other groups
operating there but Tao himself is in Hongkong.
D.C. (Special Branch)
Kao Yu-ken
D. S. I.
